title: Staircase jumping
content: Someone posted about endlessly long staircases and escalators, which triggered a memory for me. I have a recurring dream about running away from someone or multiple people while descending a staircase. To outrun them, I skip steps by doing this swinging pivot move, in which I grab the banister in the middle of the staircase, about halfway up from a landing, then jump up in the air while swinging my legs to land in the middle of the next flight of stairs. Despite being generally uncoordinated in real life, I’m quite good at this super-human, physics-defying move. And even though I know it’s a dream, when I think of it, it feels like a memory of something that’s actually happened. These aren’t necessarily tied to mall dreams. I honestly can’t think of any of the plot lines, just the staircase jumping scene. Anyone else experience something similar?
